chapters.label: The assist, live
chapters.text: Auckland, 2023. Spain against Switzerland at the World Cup. A Swiss pass runs loose, and Aitana Bonmatí pounces. She turns and slides it through to Jenni Hermoso. Left foot... Goal!

chapters.label: Look first
chapters.text: Here's how Aitana plays. Before the ball comes, she checks over her shoulder, so she already knows where Hermoso is running.

chapters.label: Turn and play forward
chapters.text: So one touch turns her to face the goal, one pass splits the defence, and Hermoso does the rest!

chapters.label: The secret
chapters.text: The secret? Check your shoulder before the ball comes. Then turn, and play forward.
